en: It's been a while since I've been\nhere.
Huh? Have you been here\nbefore, Claude?

Yeah, but last time it triggered
some pretty embarrassing
memories. I just hope no more
weird memories pop up...

I was the one who called for
this. I believe it will be a
meaningful experience for
Claude.
Eleyna, do you know what\nhappens here?
Not everything.
Even I do not understand the\nprinciples by which this place\noperates.
However, I sense a presence\nsimilar to an Oracle.
It may have been created by a\ngod, or something close to one.
Hm?
I'm leaving this house for good,\nmya!
I'm never coming back, mya! I'm\nrunning away, mya!
I see, I see. Don't be out too\nlate, stray cat.
I told you I'm never coming\nback, mya! And I'm not a stray\ncat, mya!

Now, now, don't be so angry,
stray cat. Cheer up, stray cat.
Tomorrow is another day, stray
cat.
Stop adding "stray cat" to\nevery single sentence, mya!

It sounds like there's a pretty
intense fight going on between
the inside and outside of the
house...
You think so? This is just a\nnormal conversation.
If this is "normal," poor\nMeracle...
But...
Hmm? What is it?
I feel like I've heard this\nconversation somewhere\nbefore...?
I am absolutely, positively\nnever coming back, mya!
Very well. Fare thee well.
How unfortunate. Tonight's\ndinner is a feast of fish and\npoultry...
Ah! I remember now!!

This is just like a picture book I read a
long time ago! It's a story about a Saint
and a talking cat who live happily
together while causing a ruckus every
day!
The food the Saint made\nalways looked so delicious...\n*drool*...
Hehe, how surprising. I had no\nidea my private life had been\nturned into a picture book.
Ms. Eleyna... are you actually\nsurprised? You don't look like\nit...
No, I am surprised.

Perhaps it was the work of
that painter who used to
sketch in front of my house so
often.
Eleyna is the model for the\nSaint?

No way! The Saint was beautiful, kind,
intelligent, and pure―someone who
dedicated her entire life to the world
and its people!
Those words describe me\nperfectly, don't they?

Besides, I would never have
allowed the book to be
published if she weren't
portrayed that way.
Wait, what do you mean\n"wouldn't allow it to be\npublished"...?

Oh, but hitting a cutting board
when you're mad at the
Shamune-cat might actually be
like Eleyna!
Hmph, there's a scene like\nthat?! That absolutely must be\ncorrected...
Pericci, tell me more about the\ncontents of this picture book.\nEvery single detail.

C-Captain... is this okay? Even
if it's just a picture book, I
have a feeling the future might
actually change...
Still, it's surprising that you\nand Pericci are connected\nthrough a picture book, Eleyna.
It is not as surprising as you\nthink.

The traces each person leaves behind
may be small ripples in this universe,
but those ripples lead to others,
eventually forming a great wave.

This universe seems vast, yet
it is small. The world is
connected as if everything is
heading toward a single point.

Furthermore, Pericci and I both
hail from the same planet,
Roak. It is only natural that we
would influence one another.
People from the same planet...
Ah!
Thank you all, truly...
Stop looking so gloomy. It's not\nlike we'll never see each other\nagain, right?

I actually had a pretty good
time traveling with you guys. If
anything, I'm the one who
should be thanking you.
We're friends forever, okay?
Is everyone doing okay?
How's Millie doing?
Lati... I miss you so much.
Pericci, are you all right?

Thanks to Evelysse, I can be
with everyone right now, but
once I go back to my own time,
I'll be all alone again...
Pericci...

I told you before. The worlds
influence one another. You and
Roddick are connected. You
are not alone.
But I won't be able to chat with\nMillie or have Lati pat my head!
Even if I know Lati is in the\nfuture, it still hurts to be\nlonely.
In that case, you may come\nvisit my home.
Huh?
I will be a bit older, but I will\nstill be alive in the era you live\nin.
Really?
Hehe, "I'll at least serve you\nsome tea."
Oh, I know that!
Was it in a picture book?

Yeah! When they go to the
house, there's a huge feast,
and all the Shamcats get to
eat their fill.

But the Saint says the food
isn't free, and she makes the
Shamcats work super hard to
pay for what they ate.
I see. In that case, it might be\ndangerous for you to visit my\nhome too.

I might prepare a lavish feast, only to
burden you with so many chores that
you'd have to live with me just to finish
them.
You'd better come prepared.
Eleyna...
Okay, I'll come prepared!

Write a letter to Lati? Why?
Lati isn't around in my time, so
even if I write a letter, it won't
reach her.
I see! It's just like that picture\nbook!

Pericci and Lati live on the same
planet, even if they're from different
eras. That letter might actually reach
Lati one day, Pericci.
What, really!?
Hmph, a letter. That is indeed\na fine idea.

I shall make arrangements to ensure it
reaches Roddick once he has
completed his journey across the Sea
of Stars.
Huh?
Arrangements... what do you\nmean by that?
Do you not know my family\nname? You are quite slow,\naren't you?
Ah, here it is. Claude, come\nover here.
Is this why you asked me to\njoin you on this exploration,\nEleyna?
Yeah, it's starting.

Everyone, please leave this
town immediately. In the near
future, a storm of destruction
will ravage this place.
What on earth is going on?
It is simply someone who has\nbeen making a scene and\nshouting for a while now.

Apparently, that person is
saying that Kliku will soon be
destroyed. That's why she's
telling us to run...
How ridiculous. There is no way\nsuch a thing could happen.

That was Philia, the prophet... Just as
she said, Kliku collapsed due to a
massive earthquake and the
subsequent tsunami...

But thanks to her warning us
early, everyone was able to
escape, right? Thank
goodness!
...No, her words were so abrupt\nand unexpected that nobody\nbelieved her...
What, you mean...
Yes, many people lost their\nlives...
...It's not over yet. Watch\nclosely.
I have come to this town with a\nrequest.
A request...?
Yes. I want you to kill me.
What!?

I want you to take my life
before my consciousness is
completely consumed by my
father.
Kill her!? Why on earth would\nshe say something like that!!

...She was a part of Gabriel, one of the
Ten Sages who desired the collapse of
the entire universe―the very enemy we
were fighting.

She believed that if her father's
consciousness, which was also a part
of Gabriel, fully awakened, the collapse
of the universe would be unavoidable...
So that's why she asked you to\nkill her? That's just too sad...

At the time, I didn't understand her
intentions, and in the end, her
consciousness was erased by her
father after he discovered her
betrayal...
...I still don't know. I don't know\nwhat I should have done back\nthen.

If I had followed her words and killed
her, I might have been able to save not
only the universe, but Energy Nede as
well, just as she wanted.
But there's no way I could have\ndone that...!

And just like with Kliku, I couldn't bring
myself to believe her words, and this
time, I ended up destroying an entire
planet.
Even though she was willing to\ngive her own life to protect it...!
Claude...
Eleyna, did you call me here\njust to show me this?
To tell me that the decisions I\nmade were wrong...?
Don't jump to conclusions. It is\nnot over yet.
While my father's\nconsciousness has not fully\nawakened... please, kill me...
Hurry... please!
Ugh... Father is almost awake...\nI can't even maintain my form\nanymore...
Philia...
Why are you so sorrowful?
Father!!

Please, Father! Stop this! I
don't hold a grudge against
anyone―not the people of
Nede, nor the Anti-Nede Army!
Do not make such a sad face,\nmy daughter.
I and the Ten Sages shall\neliminate everything that brings\nyou grief.
A world for only you and me...
Then, we may live in peace,\nfree from all sorrow.
...My words aren't reaching you\nanymore, are they, Father?
Once again, you wear such a\npained expression...
I see...
Is it that man you were\nspeaking of earlier!?
That man is the one causing\nyou such pain!!
No, Father! I... to him...!
I see...
I shall slaughter him at once.
Do not worry about a thing;\njust sleep peacefully.
...Father. He is my... no, he is\nthe hope of this universe.
You... won't be... trapped in\nsadness... anymore... Ku...\nKuro... will save... us...
...Father... I... hope... in a world...\nwhere we can... meet...
Could this be Philia's memory\ninstead of mine...!?

That is correct. She likely
watched you all fight from the
shadows since her time in
Expel.
And in your bravery, she found\nhope.
...Did we live up to her\nexpectations?
Who knows. Only that girl,\nPhilia, can answer that.
But we have no way of hearing\nher words anymore...
Claude! The world is\nconnected, remember! Eleyna\njust said so!
I mean, look! Philia's hopes for\nyou just got through to you,\nClaude!
I'm sure there'll be a chance to\nfind out if you lived up to them\ntoo.
Thanks, Pericci! You're right!
To make sure we don't let\nPhilia down, we have to protect\nthe peace of this world.
Alright, let's keep exploring!\nLet's go.
Two who were called\nprophets... Did he live up to\nyour expectations?
I see...

This story has come to an end.
More stories will be released in
the future. Please look forward
to them.
